✨ GIVEAWAY! ✨

I’m delighted to be teaming up with @jennyhillier_slt (the creator of @thespeechmonsters ) to give one lucky teacher access to The Speech Monsters School Programmes! 💛💜🩵

I used the Speech Monsters resources myself last year as a Junior Infants SET and honestly found them SO useful. They give you really practical, playful ways to support speech, phonics, communication, and engagement in the classroom, making it an amazing addition to any teacher or school’s resource toolkit!

The winner will get access to:

💛 Phonics & Speech — playful activities linking speech sounds and early phonics, with SLT-led videos, activities and screeners.

💜 Core Words — supporting early communication and AAC through everyday play and classroom routines, with a neuroaffirming focus on modelling rather than testing.

🩵 Let’s Engage — coming soon! 👀 A brand-new neuroaffirming programme supporting attention, engagement and listening through play, with built-in differentiation and interactive digital activities.

To enter:
💛 Follow @ciarasclassroom & @thespeechmonsters 
💛 Like this post
💛 Tag a teacher friend in the comments

You can enter as many times as you like!

Giveaway closes Monday 21st September at 6pm and the winner will be contacted shortly afterwards.

Best of luck! 🤞🏼✨

Last year in SET I used a scrapbook system for each child on School Support or School Support Plus and a split pin folder/file as a Language Book with my EAL students. This year I’m thinking of using the split pin files/folders with all of my students and call them our Learning Logs. Each child will be designing their own front cover so they have some added ownership over their Learning Log and the collection of work samples we’ll be putting inside during the year ahead. They are very simple but the children seem happy out at the moment picking which clipart they’d like to add (via Canva on my school laptop) and then we print and colour them. There is also the option for a child to choose to just print the blank version and draw their own designs by hand or add some doodles as their cover page.
